Title: Map Editor: Region
Contents: [Header]Information
Region map objects that represent areas, either for detection or for placement.
A simple explanation covering each of the Region map object types.
Note that not all of the types are present within all of the games.
[Header]AutoDrawGroupPoint
A build-time sample point for automatic draw-group generation. The game itself never reads it.
[Header]BuddySummonPoint
A region used to define a summon point for the Spirit Summon system.
[Header]Connection
A region used to define a connection between two maps.
[Header]SoundDummy
A sound dummy point: the listener's distance to it drives the Wwise RTPC DistanceFromDummyPoint_00-04 picked by its index.
[Header]EnvironmentMapEffectBox
A region used to define an area that applies environmental visual tweaks when entered by the player.
[Header]EnvironmentMapPoint
A region used to define an area that applies environmental visual tweaks when entered by the player.
[Header]EnvironmentMapOutput
A build-time marker for baking mid-range environment maps. The game itself never reads it.
[Header]FallPreventionRemoval
A build-time marker: the automatically generated fall-prevention walls are left out inside it. The game itself never reads it.
[Header]FastTravelOverride
A region that overrides the fast-travel flag: inside it, fast travel is allowed only while its event flag is ON.
[Header]GroupPlacementPoint
A group placement point: a group of enemies, placed from a RandomAppearParam row and tied to platoons, that gives a reward when all of them are defeated.
[Header]DisableHorseOverride
A region that disables Torrent inside it (1), or allows Torrent where the map would otherwise disable it (2).
[Header]Hitset
A build-time marker named after a collision model. The game itself never reads it.
[Header]InvasionPoint
A region used to define an area where an invader may appear.
[Header]WorldMapPoint

A region used to define a point that appears on the in-game map. Its discovery and re-entry areas are its own shape expanded by its ranges, or a WorldMapDiscoveryPoint / WorldMapReentryPoint region it names.
[Header]WorldMapDiscoveryPoint
A region used as a map point's discovery area, when the MapPoint names it in Discovery Region.
[Header]WorldMapReentryPoint
A region used as a map point's re-entry area, when the MapPoint names it in Re-entry Region.
[Header]MapPlaceNameOverride
A region whose Location Text ID replaces the one from the collision the player stands on, giving the area its own place-name title card.
[Header]Message
A region used to define a point where a in-game message appears on the ground.
[Header]RideJump
A Spiritspring: riding Torrent into it launches the player upwards.
[Header]RideJumpoff
The descent area of a Spiritspring. Riding into it gives the rider and Torrent the jump-off SpEffects (GameSystemCommonParam rideJumpoff_SpEffectIdPc / _SpEffectId).
[Header]DlcRideJump
A sealable Spiritspring (Shadow of the Erdtree): it only works while its event flag is ON, and shows a different SFX while sealed.
[Header]DlcRideJumpoff
The descent area of a sealable Spiritspring. Like RideJumpoff, but only active while its event flag is ON.
[Header]OcclusionBox
A room of the sound occlusion graph. Boxes sharing a Box Number form one room; its OcclusionPortals are the openings, joined by routes.
[Header]MufflingPlane
A sound muffling plane. Unused in ER; the game never references it.
[Header]OcclusionPortal
An opening of an OcclusionBox room (its Box Number). Routes join portals by Region ID.
[Header]NavmeshCutting
A build-time marker for the offline navmesh build, where neighbouring navmeshes are cut and merged. The game itself never reads it.
[Header]NPCArea
Unknown.
[Header]Other
A region used to define an area used for detection or placement.
[Header]PatrolRoute
A point along a PatrolInfo route. Its Action ID is read by AI scripts (GetMovePointActionId).
[Header]PlayRegion
A region whose Play Region ID competes with the collision's by priority (collisions are always 10). Play Regions control various multiplayer attributes.
[Header]SFX
A region used to define a point that can playback visual effects.
[Header]Sound
A region used to define a point that can emit sound.
[Header]SoundRegion
A region that overrides map sound settings (outdoor/indoor mode, Wwise place types) while the listener is inside it. Overrides only apply to Box shapes.
[Header]SpawnPoint
A region used to define a point that is used for player respawning.
[Header]WeatherCreateAssetPoint
A spawn point for weather assets, picked by WeatherAssetCreateParam CreatePoint0-3 through the number at the end of its name (WeatherCreateAssetPoint_NNN).
[Header]WeatherLotRegion
A region that overrides the weather lot and the mimicry lot-limit SpEffect flags while the player is inside.
[Header]WindArea
A region used to define an area that applies wind physics to any cloth-enabled models.
[Header]WindSFX
A region used to define an area for wind visuals.
